lessons.title: Contrast a habit and an event
lessons.objective: Contrast a habit and an event: Use the imperfetto for past habits or background: abitavo, studiavamo, aveva.
lessons.explanation:
Use the imperfetto for past habits or background: abitavo, studiavamo, aveva. It presents an ongoing or repeated past situation rather than its completed boundary. Use the passato prossimo for one finished event: ieri sono andato, abbiamo parlato.
